increments.title: The performance-test address book holds every role the plants pickers filter by
increments.detail: The k6 smoke suite seeds one address book record, Perf Test Holding, and saves it with the single role PLACE_OF_ORIGIN. Since the plants party pickers began filtering by the role each party binds, that record is offered on no picker but place of origin, so the high-risk plants journey cannot answer its consignor, place of destination or consignment contact sections, the notification is incomplete at the declaration, and the submit never reaches the confirmation page. The smoke run's own high-risk-plants threshold then fails on the single check 'submitted through the declaration page' and takes every pull request in the family red with it. The seeded record is to carry every role the journey's pickers ask for, so the walker can answer each party section, and the suite is to keep working when a picker's role changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The address the k6 suites seed is saved with every role the high-risk plants journey's pickers filter by, so each of its party sections can be answered from the address book.
The high-risk plants smoke scenario reaches the confirmation page, so the check 'submitted through the declaration page' passes and the checks{scenario:high-risk-plants} threshold is met.
The live animals smoke scenario still reaches its confirmation page, so widening the seeded record's roles breaks no other scenario.
The roles the suite seeds are derived from one place, so adding or renaming a picker's role does not need the same list edited twice.
notes: Added 17 November after inc-088 stopped at ci-red. The build loop's own CI fixer diagnosed the failure precisely and refused to act, correctly, because trade-imports-performance-tests was not in this theme's envelope: 'it is the shared k6 e2e / smoke / Smoke run job, which fails the checks{scenario:high-risk-plants} threshold on the single check submitted through the declaration page'. The repo has since been added to the envelope so the theme can fix what it broke, per CLAUDE.md rule 6.

The fix reaches CI without merging to perf-tests main: .github/workflows/smoke.yml:33-42 probes trade-imports-performance-tests for a branch of the same name as the run's and uses it when one exists, falling back to main. So the theme branch carries the fix for its own pull requests.

Evidence the seeded record is the cause: src/lib/address-book.js:12 sets ADDED_ROLE to the single value PLACE_OF_ORIGIN, and src/lib/address-book.js:39-43 saves the record with it. Separately, main's own E2E has failed about 5 times in 30 runs since 13 November with two different signatures, one of them this smoke check and one a live-animals Playwright shard; that intermittency is older than this theme and is recorded in deferred.md as its own investigation.

The page cannot be opened for a consignment it does not apply to. increments.title: The address book takes adds from germinal products notifications and returns to them
increments.detail: A trader adding an address from a germinal products notification's party picker crosses to the address book by the same handshake and the same add page as from live animals, and gets the same address record with the same fields and checks. The address book's journey conventions gain a registered germinal products entry, so saving or cancelling sends the trader back to the germinal set's own address-return page for that notification rather than to a live animals one. The return address is built on the server from that registered entry, never taken from the handshake, so no caller can redirect the trader elsewhere. Observable in the address book's own fit suite and in the Import Notification Service Playwright project, as the redirect the address book sends.
acceptanceCriteria: The address book's add page accepts a handshake naming the germinal products journey, as it accepts one naming live animals, and shows the same add page. (repo:frontend p9-134; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006, p1-061)

Saving or cancelling an add begun from a germinal products notification redirects to that notification's own address-return page under /germinal-products/notifications/{notification id}, carrying the fulfilment id, the saved address id and the handshake token, and never to a live animals notification. (repo:frontend p9-134, p9-139; trace:e2e p9-014, p9-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-009, p1-011)

The redirect is built on the server from the registered germinal products entry, and a handshake that names a return address of its own is refused. (repo:frontend p9-139; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-011)

An address saved from a germinal products notification is stored as the same record, with the same fields and the same checks, as one saved from a live animals notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006)

Options: (a) narrow the stub haystack to the six fields the service searches, re-point the search fixtures at a town or a name, and change the hint to match what search does; (b) make the address book search country (add it to SEARCHABLE_FIELDS, or send countryCodes), which is a change to trade-imports-address-book, outside this theme's repos.
